declarations.name: PerspectivePanel
declarations.summary: Perspective workspace whose data connection and layout are configured by a serializable prop.

attributes.name: hideTabs
attributes.description: Hide the viewer's internal tab strips and reclaim their space. False by default. Does not hide the wrapper toolbar or remove panels; applications provide table navigation when needed.

attributes.name: find
attributes.description: Enable a column/value filter prompt for Ctrl+F or Cmd+F in the focused Datagrid, and a Find toolbar button. Disabled by default.

attributes.name: rowActions
attributes.description: Table-name to row actions. Indexed columns accept {action, label, text?, icon?} or a list. Dedicated @ identifiers accept {header, position: start|end, buttons: [...]}. Icons: copy, delete, add, share. Buttons emit perspective-row-action with the row's index value as key, a list of values for a multi-column index; applications own confirmation, authorization and mutations. Grouped/split or unindexed rows are disabled.

attributes.name: toolbar
attributes.description: Show the table picker, close table panels button, and Copy selection button. Panel defaults are keyed by table name in config.panel_defaults.

attributes.name: themes
attributes.description: Theme names offered by the status-bar picker; light/dark map to Pro Light/Pro Dark.

attributes.name: autosize
attributes.description: Auto-size mode (on by default); disable to drive resizes imperatively.

attributes.name: autopause
attributes.description: Auto-pause rendering while the element is not visible (on by default).

attributes.name: throttle
attributes.description: Render throttle in milliseconds; unset restores adaptive throttling.

attributes.name: settings
attributes.description: Whether the settings sidebar is open.

events.name: perspective-row-action
events.description: A row button was activated. Detail contains action, panel, table, column, and the typed record key: the row's index value, or a list of its index values for a multi-column index. No data is mutated automatically.

events.name: perspective-click
events.description: Fires when a plugin's grid or chart is clicked, with the clicked row and a `config` whose filters reproduce it.

events.name: perspective-select
events.description: Fires when a plugin's selection changes, with the configs whose filters to insert and remove.

events.name: perspective-global-filter
events.description: Fires on a master panel's selection, before it is applied to the global filter set.

events.name: perspective-global-filter-update
events.description: Fires whenever the global filter set changes, with the new `Filter[]`.

events.name: perspective-config-update
events.description: Fires after a panel's view config changes, with a deferred `getConfig()` accessor valid only during dispatch.

events.name: perspective-toggle-settings
events.description: Fires after the settings sidebar opens or closes, with the new open state.

events.name: perspective-statusbar-pointerdown
events.description: Fires with the original `pointerdown` as its detail when the status bar is pressed.

events.name: perspective-table-delete
events.description: Fires after a panel's `Table` is deleted and the panel unloaded.

events.name: perspective-ready
events.description: One-shot: the panel connected, loaded its tables, and applied and rendered its initial workspace config.

events.name: perspective-error
events.description: A config apply failed (connection, mirror, or restore); detail carries the error.

events.name: perspective-copy-error
events.description: Selected-cell copying failed or the native Copy menu is unavailable over HTTP. Detail contains message and error; applications choose their notification UI.

members.name: saveWorkspace
members.description: Save the whole workspace with retained_panel_configs_by_table metadata after queued work completes.

members.name: save
members.description: Compatibility workspace save using legacy closed_channels metadata.

members.name: exportData
members.description: Export CSV (default) or JSON text without synthetic action value columns. Options: panel (defaults to active panel), format (csv or json). Retains filtering, sorting, grouping and expressions; exports the configured view, not a selected block. The temporary view is deleted after export.

members.name: openFind
members.description: Open the column/value filter prompt for the active panel when find is enabled.

members.name: copySelection
members.description: Copy the focused grid's selected text. Call directly from a user gesture. Resolves true on success, false on cancellation, no selection, or failure.

members.name: openTablePanel
members.description: Open or select a panel for a configured table using its retained panel configuration or defaults.

members.name: showTable
members.description: Select an existing detail panel for a table or open one from its configured defaults, replacing filter clauses only on supplied columns. Preserves other panels and split proportions. Resolves to the selected panel ID through the lifecycle queue.

members.name: closeTablePanels
members.description: Close every panel for a table, including master panels, retaining one last panel configuration per table.

members.name: restorePanel
members.description: Apply a partial viewer configuration to one existing panel through the lifecycle queue. Rejects unknown panel IDs and invalid configurations.

members.name: savePortableWorkspace
members.description: Save the workspace without panel themes or column width overrides, using retained_panel_configs_by_table metadata.

members.name: saveClean
members.description: Compatibility alias for savePortableWorkspace(), writing legacy closed_channels metadata.
